description: A single black lace-up shoe sits on a green-covered bed in front of you, with the laces spread out to either side. The left hand and right hand each take an end of the shoelace, cross the ends over the tongue, loop and pull to tighten, then form a bow by making loops and pulling the loops and lace ends outward to snug the knot before easing tension as if to untie or reset it.
